scenes.image: A small, round, red "SUBSCRIBE" button icon with tiny arms and legs, big expressive eyes, and a white athletic headband. A tear-shaped coin drips from its side. [[SUB_BHAI]] looks directly at the viewer, startled.
scenes.speaker: SUB_BHAI
scenes.line: Arre bhai! Main hoon Subscription! Tera paisa chaat jaata hoon!
scenes.say: अरे भाई! मैं हूँ सब्स्क्रिप्शन! तेरा पैसा चाट जाता हूँ!

scenes.image: A small, round, red "SUBSCRIBE" button icon with tiny arms and legs, big expressive eyes, and a white athletic headband. A tear-shaped coin drips from its side. [[SUB_BHAI]] looks directly at the viewer, startled.
scenes.speaker: SUB_BHAI
scenes.line: Bhule-bisre chhote subscriptions, jeb ko dheere-dheere khaali karte hain.
scenes.say: भूले-बिसरे छोटे सब्सक्रिप्शन, जेब को धीरे-धीरे खाली करते हैं।

scenes.image: A small, round, red "SUBSCRIBE" button icon with tiny arms and legs, big expressive eyes, and a white athletic headband. A tear-shaped coin drips from its side. [[SUB_BHAI]] looks directly at the viewer, startled.
scenes.speaker: SUB_BHAI
scenes.line: Har mahine ek baar check kar le, nahi toh lagega choona, bhidu!
scenes.say: हर महीने एक बार चेक कर ले, नहीं तो लगेगा चूना, भिडू!

scenes.image: A worn-out, brown leather wallet with a small sad face, big eyes, and a red bandana. Its mouth is slightly open, as if sighing. No money inside, just a few cobwebs. [[BATTUA_BHAI]] shakes its empty self.
scenes.speaker: BATTUA_BHAI
scenes.line: Main hoon Battua Bhai! Meri taraf dekh! Ek dum khaali ho gaya hoon.
scenes.say: मैं हूँ बटुआ भाई! मेरी तरफ देख! एक दम खाली हो गया हूँ।

scenes.image: A worn-out, brown leather wallet with a small sad face, big eyes, and a red bandana. Its mouth is slightly open, as if sighing. No money inside, just a few cobwebs. [[BATTUA_BHAI]] shakes its empty self.
scenes.speaker: BATTUA_BHAI
scenes.line: Ye chhote-chhote subscriptions milke budget mein chhed kar dete hain.
scenes.say: ये छोटे-छोटे सब्सक्रिप्शन मिलके बजट में छेद कर देते हैं।

scenes.image: A worn-out, brown leather wallet with a small sad face, big eyes, and a red bandana. Its mouth is slightly open, as if sighing. No money inside, just a few cobwebs. [[BATTUA_BHAI]] shakes its empty self.
scenes.speaker: BATTUA_BHAI
scenes.line: Monthly statement zaroor dekh, pata chalega kahaan jaa raha paisa.
scenes.say: मंथली स्टेटमेंट ज़रूर देख, पता चलेगा कहाँ जा रहा पैसा।

scenes.image: A cheerful, pastel-colored calendar page, ripped from a diary, with smiling eyes, small hands and feet, and a yellow flower headband. [[TAREEKH_DIDI]] points to a specific date with a helpful expression.
scenes.speaker: TAREEKH_DIDI
scenes.line: Main hoon Tareekh Didi! Yaadein dilaana mera kaam hai, samjhe?
scenes.say: मैं हूँ तारीख़ दीदी! यादें दिलाना मेरा काम है, समझे?

scenes.image: A cheerful, pastel-colored calendar page, ripped from a diary, with smiling eyes, small hands and feet, and a yellow flower headband. [[TAREEKH_DIDI]] points to a specific date with a helpful expression.
scenes.speaker: TAREEKH_DIDI
scenes.line: Aksar free trial lete hain, phir bhool jaate hain, charge hota rehta hai.
scenes.say: अक्सर फ्री ट्रायल लेते हैं, फिर भूल जाते हैं, चार्ज होता रहता है।

scenes.image: A cheerful, pastel-colored calendar page, ripped from a diary, with smiling eyes, small hands and feet, and a yellow flower headband. [[TAREEKH_DIDI]] points to a specific date with a helpful expression.
scenes.speaker: TAREEKH_DIDI
scenes.line: Calendar pe mark kar le, har mahine subscription review ka din.
scenes.say: कैलेंडर पे मार्क कर ले, हर महीने सब्सक्रिप्शन रिव्यू का दिन।

scenes.image: A small, round, red "SUBSCRIBE" button icon with tiny arms and legs, big expressive eyes, and a white athletic headband. A tear-shaped coin drips from its side. [[SUB_BHAI]] looks confused, shrugging its shoulders.
scenes.speaker: SUB_BHAI
scenes.line: Kitne app hain jo tune download kiye, phir istemal nahi kiye?
scenes.say: कितने ऐप हैं जो तूने डाउनलोड किए, फिर इस्तेमाल नहीं किए?

scenes.image: A small, round, red "SUBSCRIBE" button icon with tiny arms and legs, big expressive eyes, and a white athletic headband. A tear-shaped coin drips from its side. [[SUB_BHAI]] looks confused, shrugging its shoulders.
scenes.speaker: SUB_BHAI
scenes.line: Phir bhi har mahine teri jeb se paisa nikaalte rehte hain.
scenes.say: फिर भी हर महीने तेरी जेब से पैसा निकालते रहते हैं।

scenes.image: A small, round, red "SUBSCRIBE" button icon with tiny arms and legs, big expressive eyes, and a white athletic headband. A tear-shaped coin drips from its side. [[SUB_BHAI]] looks confused, shrugging its shoulders.
scenes.speaker: SUB_BHAI
scenes.line: Arre bhai, thoda smart ban! Ye sab faaltu ke kharch hain!
scenes.say: अरे भाई, थोड़ा स्मार्ट बन! ये सब फालतू के खर्च हैं!

scenes.image: A worn-out, brown leather wallet with a small sad face, big eyes, and a red bandana. Its mouth is slightly open, as if sighing. No money inside, just a few cobwebs. [[BATTUA_BHAI]] looks frustrated, banging its side lightly.
scenes.speaker: BATTUA_BHAI
scenes.line: Ye chhoti-chhoti baatein hi bade lafde karti hain, samjhe kya?
scenes.say: ये छोटी-छोटी बातें ही बड़े लाफड़े करती हैं, समझे क्या?

scenes.image: A worn-out, brown leather wallet with a small sad face, big eyes, and a red bandana. Its mouth is slightly open, as if sighing. No money inside, just a few cobwebs. [[BATTUA_BHAI]] looks frustrated, banging its side lightly.
scenes.speaker: BATTUA_BHAI
scenes.line: Yahi paisa bacha ke sahi jagah lagaayega toh fayda hoga, maalik.
scenes.say: यही पैसा बचा के सही जगह लगाएगा तो फायदा होगा, मालिक।

scenes.image: A worn-out, brown leather wallet with a small sad face, big eyes, and a red bandana. Its mouth is slightly open, as if sighing. No money inside, just a few cobwebs. [[BATTUA_BHAI]] looks frustrated, banging its side lightly.
scenes.speaker: BATTUA_BHAI
scenes.line: Par dhyaan rahe, nivesh baazar jokhimon ke adheen hain, expert se pooch.
scenes.say: पर ध्यान रहे, निवेश बाज़ार जोखिमों के अधीन हैं, एक्सपर्ट से पूछ।

scenes.image: A cheerful, pastel-colored calendar page, ripped from a diary, with smiling eyes, small hands and feet, and a yellow flower headband. [[TAREEKH_DIDI]] smiles knowingly, nodding her head.
scenes.speaker: TAREEKH_DIDI
scenes.line: Toh samjhe, regular checkup bahut zaroori hai apne finance ka.
scenes.say: तो समझे, रेगुलर चेकअप बहुत ज़रूरी है अपने फाइनेंस का।

scenes.image: A cheerful, pastel-colored calendar page, ripped from a diary, with smiling eyes, small hands and feet, and a yellow flower headband. [[TAREEKH_DIDI]] smiles knowingly, nodding her head.
scenes.speaker: TAREEKH_DIDI
scenes.line: Jo nahi chahiye, use turant band kar, tension nahi lene ka!
scenes.say: जो नहीं चाहिए, उसे तुरंत बंद कर, टेंशन नहीं लेने का!

scenes.image: A cheerful, pastel-colored calendar page, ripped from a diary, with smiling eyes, small hands and feet, and a yellow flower headband. [[TAREEKH_DIDI]] smiles knowingly, nodding her head.
scenes.speaker: TAREEKH_DIDI
scenes.line: Aapka sabse ajeeb bhoola hua subscription kaun sa tha? Batao!
scenes.say: आपका सबसे अजीब भूला हुआ सब्सक्रिप्शन कौन सा था? बताओ!
